fcm_receiver_unavailable.title: Doorbell notifications are unavailable for {entry_title}
fcm_receiver_unavailable.description:
Doorbell calls are not reaching Home Assistant — account {entry_title}. Cameras, locks, balance and history work as usual.

The integration is already trying to reconnect. If this warning stays:

1. Reload the account — that usually does it.
2. Still there? Reconnect it.
3. Still there? Update the integration and report the problem.

answer.name: Answer doorbell call
answer.description: Answer the currently ringing intercom call and start two-way audio.

create_home_invite.name: Invite to the home
create_home_invite.description: Create an invitation link to one address for a family member or a guest and return it to the caller. Whoever accepts the link becomes a user of that address in the operator's app; anyone who sees the link can accept it. The integration neither stores nor logs it, but the response ends up in a script trace if you capture it with response_variable.

device_id.name: Place
device_id.description: The place device to invite the person to.

create_temporary_access.name: Create temporary access
create_temporary_access.description: Create a time-limited link to selected doors of one address and return it to the caller. Whoever opens the link can open those doors until it expires; anyone who sees it can use it. The integration neither stores nor logs the link, but the response ends up in a script trace if you capture it with response_variable. Admin only.

device_id.name: Place
device_id.description: The place device whose doors to grant.

ttl.name: Lifetime (seconds)
ttl.description: Link lifetime; must be one of the values the operator allows for this address (e.g. 3600, 14400, 43200, 86400).

access_control_ids.name: Access control IDs
access_control_ids.description: Which objects to grant, by id — take them from List temporary access. Leave empty to grant every object available for this address.

list_temporary_access.name: List temporary access
list_temporary_access.description: List the temporary-access links issued for one address: id, status, expiry and objects, plus the address objects with their ids for granting. The link itself is never returned — use the id to revoke. Admin only.

device_id.name: Place
device_id.description: The place device to list issued links for.

revoke_temporary_access.name: Revoke temporary access
revoke_temporary_access.description: Revoke an issued temporary-access link by its id and confirm it is gone. Admin only.

device_id.name: Place
device_id.description: The place device the link belongs to.

pass_id.name: Pass ID
pass_id.description: The id of the issued link, from List temporary access.

cannot_lock.message: The intercom cannot be locked: the latch is released by the hardware and locks itself after a few seconds.

cannot_unlock.message: The intercom did not open: the operator rejected the request or is unreachable.

dnd_rejected.message: The operator did not accept the Do Not Disturb change.

dnd_unavailable.message: Do Not Disturb settings are not loaded yet — try again in a moment.

integration_not_loaded.message: The Elektronny Gorod integration is not loaded right now.

invite_empty.message: The operator answered without a link, so there is nothing to send.

invite_not_a_place.message: Pick a place device: a camera or an intercom is not an address the operator can invite someone to.

invite_operator_unsupported.message: Home invitations are not confirmed for this operator yet, so the request was not sent.

invite_request_failed.message: The operator did not issue the invitation. Check the connection and try again.

invite_requires_admin.message: Only an administrator can create a home invitation: whoever accepts it becomes a user of the address. Automations cannot call it, because an automation drops the caller identity — run it manually or from a script.

no_active_call.message: No incoming intercom call right now — there is nothing to answer or hang up.

temp_access_requires_admin.message: Only an administrator can manage temporary access: it opens physical doors. Automations cannot call it, because an automation drops the caller identity — run it manually or from a script.

temp_access_not_connected.message: Temporary access is not connected for this address. The operator provisions the service on the address; until then the link cannot be created.

temp_access_bad_ttl.message: The operator does not allow this lifetime for the address. Allowed values (seconds): {allowed}.

temp_access_bad_control.message: One of the selected objects does not belong to this address or cannot be granted temporary access.

temp_access_no_controls.message: This address has no objects that temporary access can be granted to.

temp_access_empty.message: The operator answered without a link, so there is nothing to send.

temp_access_request_failed.message: The temporary-access request to the operator failed. Check the connection and try again.

temp_access_revoke_failed.message: The link is still listed after the revoke request, so it may still work. Try again.

temp_access_unknown_pass.message: There is no issued link with this id for the address. Get the id from List temporary access.
